# flutter_input_kit

Semantic form fields and code-only validators.

- Import: `package:flutter_input_kit/flutter_input_kit.dart`
- Validators return machine codes, never user strings
- Fields take FieldSpec / FieldText from flutter_page_kit
- Style via flutter_scale_kit + flutter_scale_theme_kit (FieldStyle enum)
- Labels and errorText localized at the call site
- No slang, riverpod, dio, supabase, firebase, or drift in lib/
